Yes, students who have passed THPT (high school) are still eligible to apply for admission even if their primary language is other than English. However, to study at a university or program taught entirely in English, they must have an IELTS score of 5.5 or higher.  

In addition, students who successfully transition to study in Taiwan (e.g., through the Swinburne Vietnam Innovation Lab) can study in Mandarin, using the official Mandarin education system. The Mandarin proficiency level is equivalent to Level 4 (B1–B2). For example, students at Asia University Vietnam can study Mandarin at their respective centers.
